ravi: noticed rollback noise right after we flipped keepalive=15s in canary. sockets drop then rapid reconnects but streaming.events panel is flat (sampling).

zoe: which canary header did you use?

ravi: x-rollout-id=canary-1998001200. proxy logs show many closes with sampled=false. example: `[10:03:12] conn=a1 close=client.reset sampled=false`.

mike: we set stream sampling to 1/200 by default. small canaries vanish.

ravi: proposal: (1) force sampling=1.0 for requests with x-rollout-id for 10m, (2) emit `stream.probe=1` (telemetry_only) on upgrade/close so we always get a signal, (3) console banner to warn about sampling during rollouts.

zoe: agree. also add `rollout_id` tag only when header present to avoid cardinality. mark probe non-billable.

mike: add runbook line: if reconnect_rate>120/min and probe_count<30 in 5m -> pause rollout.

ops-bot: incident INC-2500 created for canary telemetry visibility assigned to @ravi

ravi: will open small PR for sampling override + probe emit and coordinate console banner. leaving thread for async updates.
